summary: Reproduced the DeepSeek V3.2/V4 DSML parser returning sole arguments/input wrapper keys for the reported direct-JSON and XML string payloads. The parser now unwraps only undeclared reserved wrapper keys, maps scalar wrappers only when the tool schema provides one unambiguous property, and defers ambiguous streaming arguments until the invoke is complete. Declared arguments/input properties and ambiguous multi-property scalar signatures remain unchanged.
